summary: The logs show a sequence of performance‑related warnings and errors: Elasticsearch reports a yellow cluster health with an unassigned replica, a database query plan shift to a full sequential scan, disk I/O saturation at 100%, and a sharp increase in API latency (p99 up to 6800 ms). These observations suggest resource pressure and degraded response times but do not identify a definitive cause.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:06:00Z ERROR [search-service] Database disk read I/O saturated at 100% (full table scans on 2,000,000 rows)
evidence.interpretation: Indicates that the database storage subsystem was fully utilized, likely contributing to slower query execution.
Shows a marked latency spike for search requests, matching the period of I/O saturation.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:04:20Z WARN [search-service] [elasticsearch] ES cluster health YELLOW: unassigned replica shard on dev node - distractor
evidence.interpretation: Elasticsearch cluster health degraded to yellow, indicating reduced redundancy that may affect query routing.

evidence.excerpt: 2026-08-28T14:05:00Z WARN [search-service] [db] Query execution plan changed: Seq Scan on items (cost=0.00..45210.00 rows=500000)
evidence.interpretation: The optimizer chose a full sequential scan, which can increase load on the storage layer.
